hens_rule_text: Up to 12 domestic fowl (hens only) allowed per dwelling unit, but only in the R-1 (single-family residential) zone.
permit_notes: No permit required for keeping hens within the allowed counts and zone.
setback_notes: Pens, coops, cages or similar housing must be at least 40 ft from the window or door of any building used for human habitation.
coop_rules: Not further detailed in the sources found beyond the 40 ft setback from habitable buildings.
zoning_notes: Rule is specific to the R-1 zone; Title 10 (Zoning Regulations) of the Modesto Municipal Code.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: Modesto, CA Code of Ordinances, Title 10 Zoning Regulations (Municode)

research_notes: Numbers (12 hens, no roosters, 40 ft setback, R-1 only, no permit) are consistent across three separate search queries and both a secondary chicken-law site and Municode-indexed extracts, but the exact code section number was not found and Municode itself is region-blocked from this machine, so the primary text was not read directly.
